<!-- Delete the sections that do not apply. docs, test, ci and chore changes usually need only Problem, Change, Verification and AI use. -->

Closes #

<!-- Or the issue this follows up, or why there is none. A feat links the issue where a maintainer confirmed the direction. If this is stacked on another pull request, name it. -->

## Problem

<!-- The user-visible failure or missing capability. Bug fixes include the minimal reproduction and the affected version. -->

## Root cause

<!-- Fixes only: the mechanism that produced the behavior. -->

## Change

<!-- The implementation, why it follows the existing architecture, any intentional runtime or provider differences, and what is deliberately left out. -->

## Verification

<!-- Exact focused tests and checks. A bug fix confirms the reproduction fails without the fix and passes with it; a refactor confirms api-surface/ and existing test assertions are unchanged; a perf change attaches x-performance numbers. -->

## Screenshots

<!-- Visible UI changes only: before and after, or a short recording. -->

## Public surface

<!-- Affected packages, exports, documentation, API-reference output, templates and changesets, or None. Say so if existing behavior changes for consumers. -->

## Decision

<!-- T3 only: the issue where an owner of the affected area recorded the decision, for example #1234. -->

## AI use

<!-- Required. Which tools wrote or changed code and how you verified their output, or None. -->
